Resolves #21355

Adds `examples/scheduler/bigData` (`A year for 300 people`) for Engine 14 (`v14.0.0`, Parent: #21346, Related: #21140): 300 seeded engineers and `15,600` bookings across 52 weeks generated in-memory via a fixed Mulberry32 seed (`20261123`, zero external data files, `examples/scheduler/basic` untouched), configured with `pxPerMinute: 0.045`, `majorTickUnit: 'week'`, a `Day | Week | 3 Weeks` zoom toolbar displaying exact counts (`300 people · 15,600 bookings`), locked `Person` + unlocked `Team · Site` resource columns, and `eventStore.model` extending `Neo.timeline.model.Event` with `{name: 'kind', type: 'String', defaultValue: 'delivery'}`. Registers `scheduler-big-data` in `examples.json` and `example-captures.json`, publishes its dark-theme cover JPEG in merged [neomjs/pages#111](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/111), and adds `test/playwright/e2e/scheduler/BigDataNL.spec.mjs` to `ADAPTER_ELIGIBLE_SPECS` in `test/playwright/externalBrainSelection.mjs`.

Evidence: L4 (68/68 post-fix unit tests + 2/2 `BigDataNL.spec.mjs` whitebox E2E tests + AC-1 browser profile + deterministic `captureExamples.mjs` cover capture + Portal `#/examples/scheduler` group before/after + `1440×900` & `390×844` dark frames beside `scheduler/basic` + 2 blind swapped-order cold looks + baseline guards, `check-package-contents`, `check-file-sizes`, and `seo/verify.mjs`) -> L4 required (AC-1..AC-7).

agent-preflight: not hosted here (`neomjs/neo` has no `ai/`); the change class is declared as `capability` (`feat`) and verified against all repository PR baseline guards.

## Deltas from ticket

- Renamed the third zoom preset/button from `'Year'` (`onYear`) to `'3 Weeks'` (`onThreeWeeks`, `THREE_WEEK_ZOOM`) while keeping `pxPerMinute: 0.045` (~18 days per `1440 px` viewport on the 52-week axis) identical to the profiled counts on `#21355` and the merged `pages#111` cover.
- `examples/scheduler/bigData/index.html` omits a favicon (matching `examples/scheduler/basic/index.html`), so `BigDataNL.spec.mjs` (`trackErrors`) checks `pageerror`, HTTP responses `>= 400`, and console errors while filtering browser `/favicon.ico` 404 noise.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge OR documented search (per guide §7.1):**

- **Challenge**: The 390×844 first frame shows about two days of timeline. Person (134 px) and Team · Site (128 px) take 262 of the 390 px, and five of the fifteen visible rows have no bar. Your own cold reader scored the frame 5/10 against basic's 6/10. The ticket asks for two resource columns, so this is not a Required Action. The cheapest improvement is a narrower Person column, or folding Team · Site into the Person cell below 768 px. I am naming it so that Friday's read does not find it first.
- Non-blocking nits:
  1. All of the first 20 rows read "… Alvarez", because `last = floor(i / 20)`, and the week-0 offsets form a 0/1/2-day staircase, so the frame looks generated. Rotating the surname per row still gives 300 unique names.
  2. In `barRenderer`, `bar?.kind ?? bar?.get?.('kind')` is a hedge the contract does not need: `barDescriptor.bar` is always set (`Column.mjs:571`), so `barDescriptor.bar.kind` is enough.
  3. The inline event model re-declares `cls` and `percentDone`, which `Neo.timeline.model.Event` already defines.
  4. The hint text hardcodes "300", while the badge derives it.
